provenance: Previously saved Hays iNaturalist 12-record species samples (278 total observations across original 58 names). Exact photo metadata and source-creator credit are from the recorded photo level, not a recheck this turn.
warnings: An initial CC license string is not current license clearance. Check original image page again before downloading or web publishing and preserve photographer attribution, license URI, any source attribution and changes.

CC BY-NC / CC BY-NC-SA require determining whether the use really qualifies as NonCommercial; a municipal site, personal site, ads, sponsorship and other contexts can matter. Do not assume eligibility.
CC BY-SA requires ShareAlike handling for adaptations; check that the intended cropping/annotation is an adaptation and satisfy license terms.
ND and all-rights-reserved source photos must not be copied/modified/rehosted in this workflow without permission.
These observations have source species labels but are not independent specimen diagnoses; not all suggested photos show diagnostic parts or established wild plants.
Every taxon remains unapproved for live site publication. No image bytes were fetched or stored by this report.
